messages:
eli: quick note: saw a temporary per-token cost surge on route r-202 after last night's variant flip. tokens/sec steady, duration ~18m. looks like cache warmup.
mira: saw that too on the cost heatmap. cache_hit dropped hard. adding an annotation to the chart when a rollout is active would help avoid false alarms.
jon: agree. also we should add a preview endpoint so the rollout modal can show "expected warmup tax" + duration and a checkbox to auto-pause if cost exceeds a threshold.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary launched route=r-202 -> model=phoenix-16k-canary (pct=7%)
mira: telemetry: we need route_id and is_canary on token samples and bump sampling for canaries (x5 for first 60m) so the preview has low variance.
eli: action items: 1) telemetry schema change (jon/mira). 2) cost-preview API + compute logic (jon). 3) UI: rollout modal card + chart annotation (eli). I'll create RFC and tag ux/telemetry/infra.
jon: will prototype cost_preview API shape in the next sprint.
